Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping.
Require Import Transformation TransformationTerm TransformationLifting.
Require Import TransformationConfig TransformationSwapCalls TransformationIterateSim.
Require Import ConfigTyping OperationalSemantics TypedOperationalSemantics.

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Context (Hms : mode_has_sef typing_mode).

Context (Hmm : mode_has_mutability typing_mode).

Theorem swap_calls_transformation_guarantee ta tb Ta Tb:
  〈ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ ta ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm typing_mode (trf_swap_calls_local typing_mode))∼> 〈ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ tb ∶ Tb〉 ->
  closed ta ->
  closed tb ->
  closed Ta ->
  closed Tb ->

  exists Ca Cb,
    config_initial ta Ca /\
    config_initial tb Cb /\
    (
      ( exists  na nb Ga2 Gb2 Ca2 Cb2,

        nb <= na /\

        ctx_empty ⊢ Ca ∶ Ta ⊣na↦* Ga2 ⊢ Ca2 /\
        ctx_empty ⊢ Cb ∶ Tb ⊣nb↦* Gb2 ⊢ Cb2 /\
        answer Ca2 /\
        answer Cb2 /\

        〈Ga2 ⊢ Ca2 ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_lift_sim_conf typing_mode (trf_swap_calls_local typing_mode))∼> 〈Gb2 ⊢ Cb2 ∶ Tb〉
      ) \/ (
         forall (n : nat),
         exists (Ca2 Cb2 : config),
           Ca ⊣n↦* Ca2 /\
           Cb ⊣n↦* Cb2
      )
    ).

End WithTypingMode.
# A dependency directory is named after its Rocq library (for example, Metalib).
LIBRARIES := $(wildcard .rocq-deps/*)
LIBRARY_FLAGS := $(foreach lib,$(LIBRARIES),-R $(lib) $(notdir $(lib)))

.PHONY: all clean
all: Makefile.coq
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq

Makefile.coq: _CoqProject Makefile
	rocq makefile -f _CoqProject $(LIBRARY_FLAGS) -o Makefile.coq

clean:
	$(MAKE) -f Makefile.coq clean

| ty_var_sub : forall G e x T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ U

| ty_var_mut_top : forall G e x T,
    mode_has_mutability typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_top)

with subtyp : Subtyping :=

| subtyp_top: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_top

| subtyp_bot: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_bot <: T

| subtyp_refl: forall G e T,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: T

| subtyp_trans: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U

| subtyp_and11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: T

| subtyp_and12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_and T U <: U

| subtyp_and2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: typ_and T U

| subtyp_or11: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or12: forall G e T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: typ_or T U

| subtyp_or2: forall G e S T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ S <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U <: T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_or S U <: T

| subtyp_fld: forall G e a T1 T2 U1 U2,
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ U1 <: U2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_fld a T2 U1) <: typ_rcd (dec_fld a T1 U2)

| subtyp_typ: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x S2) <: (open x S1)) ->
    (forall x, G⁏e ⊢ (open x T1) <: (open x T2)) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1) <: typ_rcd (dec_typ A S2 T2)

| subtyp_sel2: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ (open y S) <: typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y)

| subtyp_sel1: forall G e x A y S T,
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_typ A S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_sel (avar_f x) A (avar_f y) <: (open y T)

| subtyp_fun: forall L G e S1 T1 S2 T2,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    G⁏e ⊢ S2 <: S1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
       G § x / v_par ~ S2 ⁏e ⊢ open x T1 <: open x T2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_fun S1 T1 <: typ_fun S2 T2

| subtyp_met: forall L G e m TC1 TZ1 TR1 TC2 TZ2 TR2,
    G⁏e ⊢ TZ2 <: TZ1 ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
    G § x / v_par ~ TZ2 ⁏e ⊢ open x TC2 <: open x TC1) ->

    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC2 -> typ_indep_b 0 TC1) ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
     forall y, y <> x -> y \notin L ->
    (ctx_met G x TZ2 y TC2) ⁏e ⊢ open_met x y TR1 <: open_met x y TR2) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC1 TZ1 TR1) <: typ_rcd (dec_met m TC2 TZ2 TR2)

| subtyp_tyq: forall G e T1 T2,
    e ⊢ T1 ≈ T2 ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T1 <: T2

| subtyp_typ_and: forall G e A S1 T1 S2 T2,
    G⁏e ⊢
     typ_and
       (typ_rcd (dec_typ A S1 T1))

  (viewpoint_adapt _ x G objctx_empty e T1 T2)
    (at level 40, e at level 39, x at level 59, T1 at level 59, T2 at level 59).

Notation typ_objlit typing_mode T := (
  match (mode_objlit_refcaps' typing_mode) with

  | mode_objlit_refcaps_none => typ_and (typ_bnd T) typ_top

  | mode_objlit_refcaps_mutable => typ_and (typ_bnd T) (typ_mut_marker typ_bot)
  end) (only parsing).

Notation vis_var typing_mode G x := (
  (mode_has_visibility typing_mode) -> (ctx_vis G x)
  ) (only parsing).

Notation mut_var_writeable typing_mode G e x := (
  (mode_has_mutability typing_mode) -> (G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (typ_mut_marker typ_bot) )
  ) (only parsing).

Section WithTypingMode.

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive ty_trm : Typing trm :=

| ty_trm_var : forall G e x T,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_var (avar_f x) ∶ T

| ty_trm_apply : forall G e x z S T,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    vis_var typing_mode G z ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_fun S T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ z ∶ S ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_apply (avar_f x) (avar_f z) ∶ open z T

| ty_trm_read : forall G e x a S T U,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ▷ T ⟶ U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_read (avar_f x) a ∶ U

| ty_trm_write : forall G e x y a S T,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    vis_var typing_mode G y ->
    mut_var_writeable typing_mode G e x ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_fld a S T) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ S ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_write (avar_f x) a (avar_f y) ∶ T

| ty_trm_call : forall G e x y m TC TZ TR,
    vis_var typing_mode G x ->
    vis_var typing_mode G y ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ typ_rcd (dec_met m TC TZ TR) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ y ∶ TZ ->
    (mode_has_sef typing_mode -> typ_indep_b 0 TC) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ x ∶ (open y TC) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_call (avar_f x) m (avar_f y) ∶ open_met y x TR

| ty_trm_let : forall L G e t u T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_let t u ∶ U

| ty_trm_lit : forall L G e l u T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ l ∶ T ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_let ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x u ∶ U) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ trm_lit l u ∶ U

| ty_trm_sub : forall G e (t : trm) T U,
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ T <: U ->
    G⁏e ⊢ t ∶ U

with ty_lit : Typing lit :=

| ty_lit_fun : forall L G e T t U,
    mode_has_fun typing_mode ->
    (forall x, x \notin L ->
      G § x / v_par ~ T ⁏e ⊢ open x t ∶ open x U) ->
    G⁏e ⊢ lit_fun T t ∶ typ_fun T U

| ty_lit_obj : forall L G e T ds,
    (forall x, x \notin L -> G §§ (objctx_lit x T) ⁏e ⊢ (open x ds) ∶ (open x T)) ->
    typ_indep_b 0 T ->
    G⁏e ⊢ lit_obj T ds ∶ typ_objlit typing_mode T

with ty_def : DecTyping def :=

| ty_def_typ : forall L G Go e A T U,
    (forall x, x \notin L -> e ⊢ (open x T) ≈ (open x U)) ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ def_typ (typ_label_normal A) T ∶d dec_typ (typ_label_normal A) U U

| ty_def_fld : forall G Go e a t T,
    vis_var typing_mode (G §§& Go) t ->
    G §§& Go⁏e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ def_fld a (avar_f t) ∶d dec_fld a T T

| ty_def_met : forall L G Go e m t TC TZ TR,
    (forall xz, xz \notin L ->
    forall xc, xc <> xz -> xc \notin L ->
    ctx_obj_met typing_mode G Go xz TZ xc TC ⁏e ⊢ open_met xz xc t ∶ open_met xz xc TR) ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ def_met m t ∶d dec_met m TC TZ TR

with ty_defs: Typing defs :=

| ty_defs_one : forall G Go e d D,
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ defs_cons defs_nil d ∶ typ_rcd D

| ty_defs_cons : forall G Go e ds d T D,
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ ds ∶ T ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ d ∶d D ->
    defs_hasnt ds (label_of d) ->
    G §§ Go⁏e ⊢ defs_cons ds d ∶ typ_and T (typ_rcd D)
.

Global Existing Instance ty_trm | 0.

Global Existing Instance ty_def | 0.

Set Implicit Arguments.

Require Import LibExtra SyntaxClasses.

Require Import Vars TransformCollect Types.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Ensembles.

Require Import Coq.Sets.Constructive_sets.

Inductive ctx: Set :=

| ctx_empty

| ctx_push: ctx -> var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx

| ctx_stop: ctx -> ctx

| ctx_hide: ctx -> ctx
.

Notation "G '§' v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push G v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "v / vk ~ T" := (ctx_push ctx_empty v vk T)
  (at level 30, vk at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʸ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_loc T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʷ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_ref T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ʳ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_recv T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ᶻ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_par T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˢ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_self T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Notation "G '§ˣ' v ~ T" := (ctx_push G v v_let T)
  (at level 30, v at level 20, T at level 20).

Fixpoint ctx_concat(G1 G2: ctx): ctx :=
match G2 with
| ctx_empty => G1
| ctx_push c v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_concat G1 c) v vk t
| ctx_stop c => ctx_stop (ctx_concat G1 c)
| ctx_hide c => ctx_hide (ctx_concat G1 c)
end.

Notation "E §& F" := (ctx_concat E F)
  (at level 28, left associativity) : env_scope.

Fixpoint ctx_map(fn: typ -> typ)(G: ctx): ctx :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => ctx_empty
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => ctx_push (ctx_map fn G1) v vk (fn t)
| ctx_stop G1 => ctx_stop (ctx_map fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => ctx_hide (ctx_map fn G1)
end.

Fixpoint ctx_collect_values(A: Set)(fn: typ -> fset A)(G: ctx): fset A :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G1 v vk t => (fn t) \u (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_stop G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
| ctx_hide G1 => (ctx_collect_values fn G1)
end.

Notation ctx_fv := (ctx_collect_values fv).

Instance CtxFreeVar : FreeVar ctx := ctx_fv.

Fixpoint ctx_keys(G: ctx): list var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => nil
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  v :: (ctx_keys G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_keys G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_keys G
end.

Fixpoint ctx_dom(G: ctx): fset var :=
match G with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push G v vk t =>  \{ v } \u (ctx_dom G)
| ctx_stop G => ctx_dom G
| ctx_hide G => ctx_dom G
end.

Notation "x '§#' E" := (x \notin (ctx_dom E)) (at level 67) : env_scope.

Inductive ctx_ok: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_ok_empty:
  ctx_ok ctx_empty
| ctx_ok_push(G: ctx)(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ):
  ctx_ok G ->
  v §# G ->
  ctx_ok (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_ok_stop(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_stop G)
| ctx_ok_hide(G: ctx):
  ctx_ok G -> ctx_ok (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_empty: ctx_weakens ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_push G v vk t:

  ctx_weakens (ctx_push G v vk t)
.

Inductive ctx_weakens_hide: ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_weakens_hide_empty: ctx_weakens_hide ctx_empty
| ctx_weakens_hide_push G v vk t:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_weakens_hide_hide G:
    ctx_weakens_hide G ->
    ctx_weakens_hide (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds: var -> typ -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v vk t)
| ctx_binds_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_push G v2 vk t2)
| ctx_binds_hide(v: var)(t: typ)(G: ctx):
    ctx_binds v t G ->
    ctx_binds v t (ctx_hide G)
.

Inductive ctx_binds_k_after: var -> varkind -> typ -> ctx -> ctx -> Prop :=
| ctx_binds_k_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):

| ctx_binds_k_n(v v2: var)(vk1 vk2: varkind)(t t2: typ)(G1 G2: ctx):
    v <> v2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t G1 G2 ->
    ctx_binds_k_after v vk1 t (ctx_push G1 v2 vk2 t2) G2
.

Fixpoint ctx_kdom(vk: varkind)(c: ctx): fset var :=
match c with
| ctx_empty => \{}
| ctx_push c v vk2 t => If (vk = vk2) then (\{ v } \u (ctx_kdom vk c)) else (ctx_kdom vk c)
| ctx_stop c => ctx_kdom vk c
| ctx_hide c => ctx_kdom vk c
end.

Definition ctx_k G v vk:=
  exists t G2, ctx_binds_k_after v vk t G G2.

Notation subst_ctx x y := (ctx_map (subst_var x y)).

Notation "G '/[§' x '->' y ']'" :=

Instance CtxSealable: Sealable ctx := ctx_seal_rec.

| ctx_vis_e(v: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):

| ctx_vis_n(v v2: var)(vk: varkind)(t: typ)(G: ctx):

Class TypingEquiv (A : Set) := typing_equiv : renv -> A -> A -> Prop.

Notation "e ⊢ a '≈' b" := (typing_equiv e a b) (at level 40, a at level 59).

Inductive tyq_var: TypingEquiv var :=
| tyq_var_refl(e: renv)(v: var):
  typing_equiv e v v
| tyq_var_binds(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  renv_binds v1 v2 e ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v2
| tyq_var_sym(e: renv)(v1 v2: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v1
| tyq_var_trans(e: renv)(v1 v2 v3: var):
  typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
  typing_equiv e v2 v3 ->
  typing_equiv e v1 v3
.

Existing Instance tyq_var.

Inductive tyq_typ: TypingEquiv typ :=
| tyq_typ_nulary(e: renv) T:
  typ_nulary T ->
    typing_equiv e T T
| tyq_typ_andor T (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
  typ_andor T ->
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (T t11 t12) (T t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fun (e: renv) t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_fun t11 t12) (typ_fun t21 t22)
| tyq_typ_fld (e: renv) a t11 t12 t21 t22:
    typing_equiv e t11 t21 ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_fld a t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_typ (e: renv) B t11 t12 t21 t22:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t12) (open x t22)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t11 t12)) (typ_rcd (dec_typ B t21 t22))
| tyq_typ_sel_normal(e: renv)(v1 v2: var) (v3: avar)(l: typ_normal_label):
    typing_equiv e v1 v2 ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel (avar_f v1) (typ_label_normal l) v3) (typ_sel (avar_f v2) (typ_label_normal l) v3)
| tyq_typ_sel(e: renv)(v1 v2: avar)(l: typ_label):
    typing_equiv e (typ_sel v1 l v2) (typ_sel v1 l v2)
| tyq_typ_bnd(e: renv)(t1 t2: typ):
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t1) (open x t2)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_bnd t1) (typ_bnd t2)
| tyq_typ_met m (e: renv) t11 t12 t13 t21 t22 t23:
    (forall x, typing_equiv e (open x t11) (open x t21)) ->
    typing_equiv e t12 t22 ->
    (forall x y, typing_equiv e (open_met x y t13) (open_met x y t23)) ->
    typing_equiv e (typ_rcd (dec_met m t11 t12 t13)) (typ_rcd (dec_met m t21 t22 t23))
.

| tyq_var_alt_eq e v:

| tyq_var_alt_ww e w1 w2 y:
    binds w1 y e ->
    binds w2 y e ->

    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_and t1 t2)
| typ_indep_or v t1 t2:
    typ_indep v t1->
    typ_indep v t2->
    typ_indep v (typ_or t1 t2)
| typ_indep_fld v a t1 t2:

| typ_indep_typ_f v a t1 t2:

Instance TrmSealable : Sealable trm := seal_rec_trm.

Instance LitSealable : Sealable lit := seal_rec_lit.

Instance DefSealable : Sealable def := seal_rec_def.

Instance DefsSealable : Sealable defs := seal_rec_defs.

Instance TrmAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax TrmOpenable TrmFreeVar TrmSubstVar := {}.

Instance LitAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax LitOpenable LitFreeVar LitSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefOpenable DefFreeVar DefSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefsAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax DefsOpenable DefsFreeVar DefsSubstVar := {}.

Instance DefLabelOf : LabelOf def :=
  fun D =>
      match D with
      | def_typ L _ => label_typ L
      | def_fld m _ => label_fld m
      | def_met m _ => label_met m
      end.

Fixpoint collect_trm {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (t: trm) : C :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a       => (f a)
  | trm_read x m      => (f x)
  | trm_apply f' a      => comb (f f') (f a)
  | trm_let t1 t2    => comb (collect_trm df f comb t1) (collect_trm df f comb t2)
  | trm_lit l t      => comb (collect_lit df f comb l) (collect_trm df f comb t)
  | trm_write x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  | trm_call x m y    => comb (f x) (f y)
  end with
collect_lit {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (l: lit) : C :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T e  => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_trm df f comb e)
  | lit_obj T ds => comb (collect df f comb T) (collect_defs df f comb ds)
  end with
collect_def {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (d: def) : C :=
  match d with
  | def_typ _ T     => (collect df f comb T)
  | def_fld _ v     => (f v)
  | def_met _ t     => (collect_trm df f comb t)
  end with
collect_defs {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (ds : defs) : C  :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil         => df
  | defs_cons tl d   => comb (collect_defs df f comb tl) (collect_def df f comb d)
  end.

Instance TrmCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_trm.

Instance LitCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_lit.

Instance DefCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_def.

Instance DefsCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_defs.

Fixpoint transform_trm (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (t : trm) (n : nat) : trm :=
  match t with
  | trm_var a      => trm_var (f a n)
  | trm_read v m    => trm_read (f v n) m
  | trm_apply f' a    => trm_apply (f f' n) (f a n)
  | trm_let t1 t2  => trm_let (transform_trm f t1 n) (transform_trm f t2 (S n))
  | trm_lit l t    => trm_lit (transform_lit f l n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | trm_write v m v2 => trm_write (f v n) m (f v2 n)
  | trm_call v m v2 => trm_call (f v n) m (f v2 n)
  end with
transform_lit (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (l : lit) (n : nat) : lit :=
  match l with
  | lit_fun T t => lit_fun (transform f T n) (transform_trm f t (S n))
  | lit_obj T ds =>
    lit_obj
      (transform f T (S n))
      (transform_defs f ds (S n))
  end with
transform_def (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (d : def) (n : nat) : def :=
  match d with
  | def_typ L T => def_typ L (transform f T (S n))
  | def_fld m e => def_fld m (f e n)
  | def_met m e => def_met m (transform_trm f e (S (S n)))
  end with
transform_defs (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (ds : defs) (n : nat) : defs :=
  match ds with
  | defs_nil       => defs_nil
  | defs_cons tl d => defs_cons (transform_defs f tl n) (transform_def f d n)
  end.

Instance TrmTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax TrmAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_trm.

Instance LitTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax LitAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_lit.

Instance DefTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_def.

Instance DefsTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax DefsAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_defs.

Require Import LibExtra Vars Terms Heap Env SyntaxClasses TransformCollect Bool.

Inductive frame : Set :=
  | frame_let : trm -> frame.

Inductive stack: Set :=
  | stack_nil: stack
  | stack_cons (f: frame) (fs: stack): stack
.

Fixpoint stack_length (fs : stack) : nat :=
  match fs with
  | stack_nil => 0
  | stack_cons _ fs' => (stack_length fs') + 1
  end.

Definition frame_fv fr := match fr with frame_let c => fv c end.

Instance FrameFreeVar : FreeVar frame := frame_fv.

Fixpoint stack_fv s: vars :=
  match s with
  | stack_nil => \{}
  | stack_cons f fs => (fv f) \u (@fv stack stack_fv fs)
  end.

Instance StackFreeVar : FreeVar stack := stack_fv.

Definition frame_subst_var x y fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (subst_var x y c) end.

Instance FrameSubstVar: SubstVar frame := frame_subst_var.

Fixpoint stack_subst_var x y st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (subst_var x y f) (@subst_var stack stack_subst_var x y fs)
  end.

Instance StackSubstVar: SubstVar stack := stack_subst_var.

Definition frame_open n x fr :=
  match fr with frame_let c => frame_let (open_rec n x c) end.

Instance FrameOpenable: Openable frame := frame_open.

Fixpoint stack_open n x st :=
  match st with
    | stack_nil => stack_nil
    | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons (open_rec (S n) x f) (@open_rec stack stack_open n x fs)
  end.

Instance StackOpenable:  Openable stack := stack_open.

Instance FrameAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax FrameOpenable FrameFreeVar FrameSubstVar := {}.

Instance StackAbstractSyntax :
  AbstractSyntax StackOpenable StackFreeVar StackSubstVar := {}.

Definition collect_frame {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (fr: frame) : C :=
  match fr with
  | frame_let t => (collect df f comb t)
  end.

Instance FrameCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax FrameAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_frame.

Fixpoint collect_stack {C: Type} (df : C) (f : avar -> C) (comb: C -> C -> C) (st: stack) : C :=
  match st with
  | stack_nil => df
  | (stack_cons fr fs) => comb (collect df f comb fr) (@collect _ _ _ _ AvarAbstractSyntax _ _ _ _ StackAbstractSyntax (@collect_stack) C df f comb fs)
  end.

Instance StackCollect : Collect AvarAbstractSyntax StackAbstractSyntax :=
  @collect_stack.

Definition transform_frame (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (fr : frame) (n : nat) : frame :=
  match fr with
  | frame_let t => frame_let (transform f t n)
  end.

Instance FrameTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax FrameAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_frame.

Fixpoint transform_stack (f : avar -> nat -> avar) (st : stack) (n : nat) : stack :=
  match st with
  | stack_nil => stack_nil
  | (stack_cons fr fs) => (stack_cons (transform f fr (S n)) (@transform _ _ _ _ AvarAbstractSyntax _ _ _ _ StackAbstractSyntax transform_stack f fs n))
  end.

Instance StackTransform : Transform AvarAbstractSyntax StackAbstractSyntax :=
  @transform_stack.

Fixpoint stack_append (fs1 fs2: stack) :=
  match fs1 with
  | stack_nil => fs2
  | stack_cons f fs => stack_cons f (stack_append fs fs2)
  end.

Definition stack_suffix fs1 fs2 := exists fs3, fs2 = stack_append fs3 fs1.

| is_sealed_top : forall n, is_sealed_typ n typ_top
| is_sealed_bot : forall n, is_sealed_typ n typ_bot
| is_sealed_rcd : forall n D, is_sealed_dec n D -> is_sealed_typ n (typ_rcd D)
| is_sealed_and : forall n T1 T2, is_sealed_typ n T1 ->
                             is_sealed_typ n T2 ->
                             is_sealed_typ n (typ_and T1 T2)
| is_sealed_or : forall n T1 T2, is_sealed_typ n T1 ->
                             is_sealed_typ n T2 ->
                             is_sealed_typ n (typ_or T1 T2)
| is_sealed_sel : forall n a L a', (forall n', n' >= n ->
                                     (avar_b n') <> a /\ (avar_b n') <> a') ->
                              is_sealed_typ n (typ_sel a L a')
| is_sealed_bnd : forall n T, is_sealed_typ (S n) T ->
                         is_sealed_typ n (typ_bnd T)
| is_sealed_fun : forall n T1 T2, is_sealed_typ n T1 ->
                             is_sealed_typ (S n) T2 ->
                             is_sealed_typ n (typ_fun T1 T2)
| is_sealed_nocap : forall n, is_sealed_typ n typ_nocap
with is_sealed_dec : nat -> dec -> Prop :=
| is_sealed_dec_typ : forall n L T U, is_sealed_typ (S n) T ->
                                 is_sealed_typ (S n) U ->
                                 is_sealed_dec n (dec_typ L T U)
| is_sealed_dec_fld : forall n L T U, is_sealed_typ n T ->
                                 is_sealed_typ n U ->
                                 is_sealed_dec n (dec_fld L T U)
| is_sealed_dec_met : forall n L TC TZ TR, is_sealed_typ (S n) TC ->
                                      is_sealed_typ n TZ ->
                                      is_sealed_typ (S (S n)) TR ->
                                      is_sealed_dec n (dec_met L TC TZ TR).

with   is_sealed_dec_mut  := Induction for is_sealed_dec Sort Prop.

Local Lemma swap_calls_free_open :
  (forall x t, tfree_trm x t -> forall k y, tfree_trm x (open_rec k y t)) /\\
  (forall x l, tfree_lit x l -> forall k y, tfree_lit x (open_rec k y l)) /\\
  (forall x d, tfree_def x d -> forall k y, tfree_def x (open_rec k y d)) /\\
  (forall x ds, tfree_defs x ds -> forall k y, tfree_defs x (open_rec k y ds)).
Proof.
  apply (tfree_mutind
    (fun x t _ => forall k y, tfree_trm x (open_rec k y t))
    (fun x l _ => forall k y, tfree_lit x (open_rec k y l))
    (fun x d _ => forall k y, tfree_def x (open_rec k y d))
    (fun x ds _ => forall k y, tfree_defs x (open_rec k y ds))).
  all: intros; cbn;
    eauto using tfree_trm, tfree_lit, tfree_def, tfree_defs.
Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_binding_in_context x T G :
  ctx_binds x T G -> x \\in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intro H. induction H; cbn; rewrite ?in_union, ?in_singleton; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_var_in_context mode G e x T :
  ty_var mode G objctx_empty e x T -> x \\in ctx_dom G.
Proof.
  intro H. induction H; auto using swap_calls_binding_in_context.
Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_typed_vars :
  (forall G Go e t T, ty_trm mode G Go e t T -> vars_in_context (G §§& Go) t) /\\

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='/tmp/rodot-call-helpers.v'
s=open(p).read().replace('Require Import ConfigTyping ConfigNotations InertContext HeapCorrespondence EnvCorrespondence.', '''Require Import ConfigTyping ConfigNotations InertContext HeapCorrespondence EnvCorrespondence.
Require Import Transformation TransformationTerm TransformationLifting.
Require Import TransformationConfig TransformationSwapCalls TransformationIterateSim.
Require Import ConfigTypingAccessories.''')
i=s.index('Local Lemma swap_calls_initial_typed')
s=s[:i]+r'''Local Lemma swap_calls_initial_typed t T Lv :
  ty_trm mode ctx_empty objctx_empty empty t T ->
  closed t ->
  closed T ->
  (exists null, null \\in Lv) ->
  fv T \\c Lv ->
  @ty_config mode ctx_empty (config_mk t stack_nil empty empty Lv) T.
Proof.
  intros Hty Ht HT Hnull Hfv.
  eapply ty_config_c with (T := T).
  - constructor.
  - exact swap_calls_empty_heap_correspond.
  - constructor. apply subtyp_refl.
  - intros x H. inversion H.
  - exact Hty.
  - intros x Hx.
    destruct swap_calls_typed_vars as [Hfree _].
    specialize (Hfree _ _ _ _ _ Hty x Hx).
    cbn in Hfree. rewrite in_empty in Hfree. contradiction.
  - repeat split.
    + simpl. intros x H. rewrite in_empty in H. contradiction.
    + unfold nothing_fresh_in_config. simpl.
      intros x H. rewrite in_empty in H. contradiction.
    + unfold nothing_fresh_in_config. simpl.
      intros x H. rewrite in_union. right. apply Hfv, H.
  - exact Hnull.
  - intros x. reflexivity.
  - constructor; try assumption; constructor.
  - exact HT.
Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_config_accessories G e fs heap t T Lv :
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk t fs heap e Lv) T ->
  @ty_config_accessories mode G e fs heap t T Lv.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst. unfold ty_config_accessories. tauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_initial_related ta tb Ta Tb :
  〈ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ ta ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼> 〈ctx_empty⁏empty ⊢ tb ∶ Tb〉 ->
  ty_trm mode ctx_empty objctx_empty empty ta Ta ->
  ty_trm mode ctx_empty objctx_empty empty tb Tb ->
  closed ta ->
  closed tb ->
  closed Ta ->
  exists Ca Cb,
    config_initial ta Ca /\\ config_initial tb Cb /\\
    〈ctx_empty ⊢ Ca ∶ Ta〉
      ∼(trf_lift_sim_conf mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼>
    〈ctx_empty ⊢ Cb ∶ Tb〉.
Proof.
  intros Hswap Hta Htb Hca Hcb HT.
  assert (Ta = Tb) by (inversion Hswap; reflexivity).
  subst Tb.
  destruct (var_fresh (fv ta \\u fv tb \\u fv Ta)) as [null _].
  set (Lv := \\{null} \\u fv Ta).
  assert (Hnull : exists n, n \\in Lv).
  { exists null. unfold Lv. rewrite in_union, in_singleton. auto. }
  assert (Hfv : fv Ta \\c Lv).
  { unfold Lv. apply subset_union_weak_r. }
  pose proof (swap_calls_initial_typed Hta Hca HT Hnull Hfv) as HinitA.
  pose proof (swap_calls_initial_typed Htb Hcb HT Hnull Hfv) as HinitB.
  eexists _, _. split; [constructor |]. split; [constructor |].
  eapply trf_iterate_S.
  - apply trf_iterate_0. exact HinitA.
  - right. apply trf_lift_idtyp_conf_focus.
    eapply trf_focus_idtyp_conf_focus with (Ts := Ta) (Tt := Ta).
    + eapply swap_calls_config_accessories; exact HinitA.
    + eapply swap_calls_config_accessories; exact HinitB.
    + exact swap_calls_empty_heap_correspond.
    + constructor. apply subtyp_refl.
    + exact Hswap.
    + apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

End WithMode.
'''
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
rocq top -quiet -R rodot roDOT -R .rocq-deps/TLC TLC -w -all < /tmp/rodot-call-helpers.v > /tmp/rodot-call-helpers.log 2>&1 && rg -n -A12 -B5 'Error' /tmp/rodot-call-helpers.log"

/bin/bash -lc "cat > /tmp/rodot-calls-answers.v <<'EOF'
Set Implicit Arguments.
Require Import LibExtra AbstractSyntax GeneralTyping.
Require Import Transformation TransformationTerm TransformationLifting.
Require Import TransformationConfig TransformationSwapCalls TransformationIterateSim.
Require Import TransformationSimilarity Similarity SyntaxSimilarity ConfigSimilarity.
Require Import ConfigTyping OperationalSemantics TypedOperationalSemantics.

Section Answers.
Context (mode : Mode).

Local Definition answer_element (e : TypedElement ctx typ config) :=
  match e with
  | typed_elem _ _ c => answer c
  end.

Local Definition focus_is_variable (t : trm) :=
  exists x, t = trm_var (avar_f x).

Local Lemma task_answer_characterization t fs h e fv :
  answer (config_mk t fs h e fv) <-> focus_is_variable t /\\ fs = stack_nil.
Proof.
  split.
  - intro H. inversion H; subst. split; [now eexists | reflexivity].
  - intros [[x ->] ->]. constructor.
Qed.

Local Lemma task_swap_focus_not_variable G e ta tb Ta Tb :
  〈G⁏e ⊢ ta ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ tb ∶ Tb〉 ->
  ~ focus_is_variable ta /\\ ~ focus_is_variable tb.
Proof.
  intro H. inversion H; subst.
  - match goal with
    | Hlocal : transform (trf_swap_calls_local _) _ _ |- _ => inversion Hlocal; subst
    end.
    split; intros [? Hcontra]; discriminate.
  all: split; intros [? Hcontra]; discriminate.
Qed.

Local Lemma task_lift_swap_preserves_answer a b :
  a ∼(trf_lift_idtyp_conf mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼> b ->
  (answer_element a <-> answer_element b).
Proof.
  intro H. destruct H.
  - inversion H; subst. cbn [answer_element].
    repeat rewrite task_answer_characterization.
    match goal with
    | Hswap : transform (trf_local_idtyp_trm _ _) _ _ |- _ =>
        destruct (task_swap_focus_not_variable Hswap) as [Ha Hb]
    end.
    tauto.
  - cbn [answer_element]. now repeat rewrite task_answer_characterization.
  - cbn [answer_element]. repeat rewrite task_answer_characterization.
    match goal with
    | Hstack : transform (trf_lift_idtyp_stack _ _) _ _ |- _ =>
        inversion Hstack; subst
    end;
    split; intros [_ Hnil]; discriminate.
Qed.

Local Lemma task_subst_vars_preserves_focus xs ys t :
  focus_is_variable (subst_vars xs ys t) <-> focus_is_variable t.
Proof.
  revert ys t.
  induction xs as [|x xs IH]; intros [|y ys] t;
    cbn [vars_zip_map]; try reflexivity.
  Show.
EOF

Local Ltac prove_rename_open H :=
  unfold rename;
  apply H.

Local Lemma rename_open_typ f k x (T : typ) :
  rename f (open_rec k x T) = open_rec k (f x) (rename f T).
Proof. prove_rename_open (proj1 (rename_open_types f)). Qed.

Local Lemma rename_open_trm f k x (t : trm) :
  rename f (open_rec k x t) = open_rec k (f x) (rename f t).
Proof. prove_rename_open (proj1 (rename_open_terms f)). Qed.

Local Lemma rename_open_defs f k x (ds : defs) :
  rename f (open_rec k x ds) = open_rec k (f x) (rename f ds).
Proof. prove_rename_open (proj2 (proj2 (proj2 (rename_open_terms f)))). Qed.

Local Lemma rename_objctx_concat f G Go :
  rename_ctx f (G §§& Go) = rename_ctx f G §§& rename_objctx f Go.
Proof. destruct Go; cbn [rename_ctx ctx_obj rename_objctx]; rewrite ?rename_open_typ; reflexivity. Qed.

Local Lemma rename_objctx_method f m G Go arg TZ recv TC :
  rename_ctx f (ctx_obj_met m G Go arg TZ recv TC) =
  ctx_obj_met m (rename_ctx f G) (rename_objctx f Go)
    (f arg) (rename f TZ) (f recv) (rename f TC).
Proof.
  destruct Go; cbn [ctx_obj_met rename_objctx];
    destruct (mode_visibility' m); cbn [rename_ctx]; rewrite ?rename_open_typ;
    reflexivity.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_binds f G x T :
  (forall x y, f x = f y -> x = y) ->
  ctx_binds x T G -> ctx_binds (f x) (rename f T) (rename_ctx f G).
Proof.
  intros Hinj Hbind. induction Hbind; cbn [rename_ctx];
    eauto using ctx_binds.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_vis f G x :
  (forall x y, f x = f y -> x = y) ->
  ctx_vis G x -> ctx_vis (rename_ctx f G) (f x).
Proof.
  intros Hinj Hvis. induction Hvis; cbn [rename_ctx];
    eauto using ctx_vis.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_avar_inj f :
  (forall x y, f x = f y -> x = y) ->
  forall x y, rename_avar f x = rename_avar f y -> x = y.
Proof.
  intros Hinj [i | x] [j | y] H; inversion H; auto.
  f_equal. auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma rename_typ_indep f a T :
  (forall x y, f x = f y -> x = y) ->
  typ_indep a T -> typ_indep (rename_avar f a) (rename f T).
Proof.
  intros Hinj H. induction H;
    cbn [rename_avar]; unfold rename in *;
    try solve [destruct H; constructor; constructor].
  all: repeat match goal with
  | H : typ_indep _ (TransformCollect.transform _ ?T 0),
    |- context [TransformCollect.transform _ ?T ?d] =>
      first [constr_eq d 0; fail 1 |
         let h := fresh in
         pose proof (proj1 (rename_depth_types f) T d 0) as h;
         change (TransformCollect.transform (avar_map f) T d =
                 TransformCollect.transform (avar_map f) T 0) in h;
         rewrite h; clear h]
  end.
  all: try solve [constructor; auto 6 using rename_avar_inj].
  Show.
EOF

Local Lemma open_transform_types k x f g :
  (forall a d, open_rec (k + d) x (f a d) =
     g (open_rec (k + d) x a) d) ->
  (forall T d, open_rec_typ (k + d) x (transform_typ f T d) =
     transform_typ g (open_rec_typ (k + d) x T) d) /\\
  (forall D d, open_rec_dec (k + d) x (transform_dec f D d) =
     transform_dec g (open_rec_dec (k + d) x D) d).
Proof.
  intro H. apply typ_mutind; intros;
    cbn [open_rec_typ open_rec_dec transform_typ transform_dec];
    try reflexivity; f_equal; rewrite ?Nat.add_succ_r; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma open_transform_terms k x f g :
  (forall a d, open_rec (k + d) x (f a d) =
     g (open_rec (k + d) x a) d) ->
  (forall t d, open_rec_trm (k + d) x (transform_trm f t d) =
     transform_trm g (open_rec_trm (k + d) x t) d) /\\
  (forall l d, open_rec_lit (k + d) x (transform_lit f l d) =

  (forall v d, open_rec_def (k + d) x (transform_def f v d) =

  (forall ds d, open_rec_defs (k + d) x (transform_defs f ds d) =
     transform_defs g (open_rec_defs (k + d) x ds) d).

  intro H. destruct (open_transform_types k x H) as [HT HD].
  apply trm_mutind; intros;
    cbn [open_rec_trm open_rec_lit open_rec_def open_rec_defs

    try reflexivity; f_equal; rewrite ?Nat.add_succ_r; auto.

  ctx_extends G G' -> ctx_extends (ctx_hide G) (ctx_hide G').

  - intros w H. inversion H.

Local Lemma ctx_extends_object G G' Go :

Require Import TransformationConfig TransformationSwapCalls TransformationIterateSim.

Local Definition starts_with_let (t : trm) :=
  (exists s u, t = trm_let s u) \\/ (exists l u, t = trm_lit l u).

Local Lemma swap_calls_let_heads mode G e ta tb Ta Tb :
  〈G⁏e ⊢ ta ∶ Ta〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ tb ∶ Tb〉 ->
  starts_with_let ta /\\ starts_with_let tb.
Proof.

    try solve [split; first [left; eauto | right; eauto]].
  match goal with
  | Hlocal : transform (trf_swap_calls_local _) _ _ |- _ =>
      inversion Hlocal; subst
  end.
  split; left; eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma no_function_literal_typing mode G e (T : typ) u U :
  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  ~ ty_trm mode G objctx_empty e (trm_lit (lit_fun T u) U) typ_top.
Proof.
  intros Hmut H. remember (trm_lit (lit_fun T u) U) as t in H eqn:Ht.
  induction H; try discriminate; eauto.
  inversion Ht; subst.
  inversion H; subst. destruct mode; discriminate.

  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk t fs heap e Lv) T ->
  starts_with_let t ->
  exists G' C', typed_red mode G (config_mk t fs heap e Lv) T G' C'.

  intros Hmut Htyping [[s [u ->]] | [[A b | A ds] [u ->]]].
  - inversion Htyping; subst.
    eexists _, _. eapply tred_let_push; eauto.
  - inversion Htyping; subst.
    exfalso. eapply no_function_literal_typing; [exact Hmut |].
    eapply ty_trm_sub; [eassumption | apply subtyp_top].
  - set (C := config_mk (trm_lit (lit_obj A ds) u) fs heap e Lv).
    set (L := fv_config C \\u (ctx_fv G \\u fv A)).
    destruct (var_fresh L) as [y Hy].
    destruct (var_fresh (L \\u \\{y})) as [w Hw].
    unfold L in Hy, Hw.
    apply notin_union in Hy as [HyC HyA].
    apply notin_union in Hw as [Hw HwY].
    apply notin_union in Hw as [HwC HwA].
    assert (Hfresh : fresh_in_config (y::w::nil)%list C).
    { cbn [fresh length]. split; [exact HyC |].
      split; [apply notin_union; auto | trivial]. }
    assert (Hinert : inert (typing_mode := mode) G) by (inversion Htyping; assumption).
    eexists _, _. eapply tred_let_obj; eauto.

Local Lemma rename_similarity_symmetric {A : Set} {AF : FreeVar A} {AS : SubstVar A}
    xs ys (a b : A) :
  similar_by_subst xs ys a b -> similar_by_subst ys xs b a.
Proof.
  intros [c [zs [Hx [Hy [Hfresh [Hfv [Ha Hb]]]]]]].
  exists c, zs. repeat split; try assumption.
  replace (fv b \\u fv a \\u from_list ys \\u from_list xs)
    with (fv a \\u fv b \\u from_list xs \\u from_list ys) by
      (apply fset_extens; intros v H; repeat rewrite in_union in *; tauto).
  exact Hfresh.
Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_env_similarity_symmetric {A : Set} (AS : Similar A) :
  (forall xs ys a b, similar xs ys a b -> similar ys xs b a) ->
  forall xs ys ks ls a b,
  similar_env_with AS xs ys ks ls a b ->
  similar_env_with AS ys xs ls ks b a.
Proof.
  intros Hvalues xs ys ks ls a b H. induction H.
  - apply similar_env_empty. symmetry. assumption.
  - eapply similar_env_dom; eauto.
  - apply similar_env_notin; auto.

Require Import LibExtra.

Require Import AbstractSyntax TypingMode GeneralTyping EnvCorrespondence TFree ConfigVarkinds Defs RecordDefs.

Inductive defs_update : defs -> fld_label -> var -> defs -> Prop :=
| defs_update_var : forall ds a t x,
    defs_update (defs_cons ds (def_fld a t)) a x (defs_cons ds (def_fld a (avar_f x)))
| defs_update_push : forall ds d a x ds',
    defs_update ds a x ds' ->
    label_of d <> (label_fld a) ->
    defs_update (defs_cons ds d) a x (defs_cons ds' d).

Definition heap_update (s : heap) (x : var) (a : fld_label) (y : var) (s' : heap) :=
  ok s /\
  ok s' /\
  (dom s) = (dom s') /\
  (forall z v, z <> x ->
          binds z v s ->
          binds z v s') /\
  exists ds ds', binds x (item_obj ds) s /\
              defs_update ds a y ds' /\
              binds x (item_obj ds') s'.

  def_varkinds G (def_fld l (avar_f x))

| def_varkinds_typ G T l:

| defs_varkinds_nil G:

  defs_varkinds G ds ->
  def_varkinds G d ->
  defs_varkinds G (defs_cons ds d)

Require Import HeapUpdate ConfigVarkinds.

Local Lemma kinded_binding_in_context x k T G G' :
  ctx_binds_k_after x k T G G' -> x \\in ctx_kdom k G.
Proof.
  intro H. induction H; cbn [ctx_kdom]; case_if; try congruence;
    rewrite ?in_union, ?in_singleton; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma kinded_binding_in_suffix x k T G G' :
  ctx_binds_k_after x k T G G' -> forall k', ctx_kdom k' G' \\c ctx_kdom k' G.
Proof.
  intro H. induction H; intros k' v Hv; cbn [ctx_kdom];
    case_if; rewrite ?in_union; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma reference_target_in_context mode G e w y :
  @renv_corr mode G e -> binds w y e -> y \\in ctx_kdom v_loc G.
Proof.
  intros Hcorr. induction Hcorr; intro Hbind.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv; eassumption.
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hbind.
    destruct Hbind as [[-> ->] | [_ Hbind]].
    + eapply kinded_binding_in_suffix.
      * eassumption.
      * eapply kinded_binding_in_context; eassumption.
    + auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma no_functions_in_mutability_mode mode :
  mode_has_mutability mode -> mode_has_fun' mode = false.
Proof. destruct mode; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Local Lemma reference_lookup mode G e h w :
  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  @heap_correspond mode G e h ->
  ctx_k G w v_ref ->
  exists y ds, binds w y e /\\ binds y (item_obj ds) h /\\ defs_varkinds G ds.
Proof.
  intros Hmut [_ [_ [_ [_ [Hloc [Href [Henv Hitems]]]]]]]
    [T [G' Hbind]].
  assert (Hdom : w \\in dom e).
  { rewrite <- Href. eapply kinded_binding_in_context; eassumption. }
  destruct (get_some Hdom) as [y Hy].
  assert (HdomY : y \\in dom h).
  { rewrite <- Hloc. eapply reference_target_in_context; eassumption. }
  specialize (Hitems _ HdomY). destruct Hitems.
  - exfalso. match goal with Hfun : mode_has_fun' mode = true |- _ =>
      rewrite (no_functions_in_mutability_mode Hmut) in Hfun; discriminate
    end.
  - eexists _, _. repeat split; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma def_lookup_kinded G ds d :
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds d -> def_varkinds G d.
Proof.
  intro H. induction H; unfold defs_has in *; cbn [get_def]; intro Hget.
  - discriminate.
  - case_if. 
    + inversion Hget; subst. assumption.
    + auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma lookup_field_location G ds a v :
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_fld a v) ->
  exists y, v = avar_f y /\\ ctx_k G y v_loc.
Proof.
  intros Hdefs Hhas.
  pose proof (def_lookup_kinded Hdefs Hhas) as Hkind. inversion Hkind; subst.
  eexists. split; [reflexivity | eassumption].
Qed.

Local Lemma heap_lookup_transport mode G t fs h e Lv T w :
  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk t fs h e Lv) T ->
  tfree_trm w t ->
  exists y ds, binds w y e /\\ binds y (item_obj ds) h /\\ defs_varkinds G ds.
Proof.
  intros Hmut Hty Hfree. inversion Hty; subst.
  eapply reference_lookup; [exact Hmut | eassumption |].
  match goal with H : all_tfree_k _ t v_ref |- _ =>
    apply H; exact Hfree
  end.
Qed.

Local Lemma defs_update_has_field ds a v y :
  defs_has ds (def_fld a v) -> exists ds', defs_update ds a y ds'.
Proof.
  unfold defs_has; cbn [label_of DefLabelOf].
  induction ds as [|ds IH d]; cbn [get_def]; intro H.
  - discriminate.
  - case_if.
    + inversion H; subst. eexists. constructor.
    + destruct (IH H) as [ds' Hds']. exists (defs_cons ds' d).
      apply defs_update_push; assumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma replace_heap_item h x i i' :
  ok h ->
  binds x i h ->
  exists h',
    ok h' /\\ dom h' = dom h /\\ binds x i' h' /\\
    (forall z v, z <> x -> binds z v h -> binds z v h').
Proof.
  intros Hok. induction Hok as [|h z v Hok IH Hfresh]; intro Hbind.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv; eassumption.
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hbind. destruct Hbind as [[-> ->] | [Hneq Hbind]].
    + exists (h & z ~ i'). repeat split.
      * apply ok_push; assumption.
      * now rewrite "'!dom_push.
      * apply binds_push_eq.
      * intros z'"' v' Hneq' Hbind. apply binds_push_inv in Hbind.
        destruct Hbind as [[Heq _] | [_ Hbind]]; [congruence |].
        apply binds_push_neq; assumption.
    + destruct (IH Hbind) as [h' [Hok' [Hdom [Hbind' Hothers]]]].
      exists (h' & z ~ v). repeat split.
      * apply ok_push; [exact Hok' |]. unfold notin in *. rewrite Hdom. exact Hfresh.
      * now rewrite "'!dom_push, Hdom.
      * apply binds_push_neq; assumption.
      * intros z'"' v' Hneq' Hbind''. apply binds_push_inv in Hbind''.
        destruct Hbind'' as [[-> ->] | [Hneq'' Hb]].
        -- apply binds_push_eq.
        -- apply binds_push_neq; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma update_existing_field h x ds a v y :
  ok h ->
  binds x (item_obj ds) h ->
  defs_has ds (def_fld a v) ->
  exists h', heap_update h x a y h'.
Proof.
  intros Hok Hbind Hfield.
  destruct (defs_update_has_field y Hfield) as [ds' Hds'].
  destruct (replace_heap_item (item_obj ds') Hok Hbind)
    as [h' [Hok' [Hdom [Hbind' Hothers]]]].
  exists h'. repeat split; try assumption.
  - symmetry. assumption.
  - exists ds, ds'. auto.
Qed.

item.text: I’ve checked preservation for `let` pushes, progress for variable and `let` control cases, and the heap lookup facts for method calls and field writes. I’m using these to prove the synchronized steps that expose a nested swap.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "cat >>/tmp/PreserveLets.v <<'EOF'

Local Lemma local_swap_widen mode G e ta tb T T' :
  〈G⁏e ⊢ ta ∶ T〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ tb ∶ T〉 ->
  subtyp mode G objctx_empty e T T' ->
  〈G⁏e ⊢ ta ∶ T'〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ tb ∶ T'〉.
Proof.
  intros H Hsub. inversion H; subst; unfold subtyping in *.
  all: try solve [eapply trf_local_idtyp_trm_local; unfold subtyping; eauto using subtyp_trans].
  all: try solve [eapply trf_local_idtyp_trm_letl with (L := L); unfold subtyping; eauto using subtyp_trans].
  all: try solve [eapply trf_local_idtyp_trm_letr with (L := L); unfold subtyping; eauto using subtyp_trans].
  all: try solve [eapply trf_local_idtyp_trm_litl with (L := L); unfold subtyping; eauto using subtyp_trans].
  all: try solve [eapply trf_local_idtyp_trm_litr with (L := L); unfold subtyping; eauto using subtyp_trans].
Qed.

Local Definition let_pushed s u fs h e Lv :=
  config_mk s (stack_cons (frame_let u) fs) h e
    (fv_config (config_mk (trm_let s u) fs h e Lv)).

Local Lemma one_typed_let_push mode G s u fs h e Lv T :
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk (trm_let s u) fs h e Lv) T ->
  typed_red_closure mode G (config_mk (trm_let s u) fs h e Lv) T 1 G
    (let_pushed s u fs h e Lv).
Proof.
  intro H.
  eapply typed_red_step; [apply typed_red_refl |].
  unfold let_pushed. eapply tred_let_push; eauto. inversion H; assumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma weaken_under_fresh_binder mode G e x V T T' :
  x \\notin ctx_dom G ->
  subtyp mode G objctx_empty e T T' ->
  subtyp mode (G §ˣ x ~ V) objctx_empty e T T'.
Proof.
  intros Hx Hsub.
  eapply (proj1 (proj2 (ctx_extends_types mode))); [exact Hsub |].
  now apply ctx_extends_with_fresh.
Qed.

Local Lemma original_let_stack_for_swapped_focus mode G e fs u L S T Ts T0 :
  @ty_stack mode G e Ts fs T0 ->
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> ty_trm mode (G §ˣ x ~ S) objctx_empty e (open x u) T) ->
  subtyp mode G objctx_empty e T Ts ->
  @ty_stack mode G e S (stack_cons (frame_let u) fs) T0.
Proof.
  intros Hstack Hu Hsub.
  eapply ty_stack_let with (L := L \\u ctx_dom G); [exact Hstack |].
  intros x Hx. apply notin_union in Hx as [HxL HxG].
  eapply ty_trm_sub; [apply Hu; exact HxL |].
  now apply weaken_under_fresh_binder.
Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_step_let_left mode G e fs h sa sb u S T Ts T0 La Lb L :
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk (trm_let sa u) fs h e La) T0 ->
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk (trm_let sb u) fs h e Lb) T0 ->
  〈G⁏e ⊢ sa ∶ S〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ sb ∶ S〉 ->
  @ty_stack mode G e Ts fs T0 ->
  (forall x, x \\notin L -> ty_trm mode (G §ˣ x ~ S) objctx_empty e (open x u) T) ->
  subtyp mode G objctx_empty e T Ts ->
  typed_red_closure mode G (config_mk (trm_let sa u) fs h e La) T0 1 G (let_pushed sa u fs h e La) /\\
  typed_red_closure mode G (config_mk (trm_let sb u) fs h e Lb) T0 1 G (let_pushed sb u fs h e Lb) /\\
  〈G ⊢ (let_pushed sa u fs h e La) ∶ T0〉
    ∼(call_swap_relation mode)∼>
  〈G ⊢ (let_pushed sb u fs h e Lb) ∶ T0〉.
Proof.
  intros Htya Htyb Hswap Hstack Hu Hsub.
  repeat split; try (apply one_typed_let_push; assumption).
  pose proof (let_push_preservation Htya) as Htya'.
  pose proof (let_push_preservation Htyb) as Htyb'.
  unfold let_pushed. eapply trf_iterate_S.
  - apply trf_iterate_0. exact Htya'.
  - right. apply trf_lift_idtyp_conf_focus.
    eapply trf_focus_idtyp_conf_focus with (Tt := S) (Ts := S).
    + eapply swap_calls_config_accessories. exact Htya'.
    + eapply swap_calls_config_accessories. exact Htyb'.
    + inversion Htya'; assumption.
    + eapply original_let_stack_for_swapped_focus; eassumption.
    + exact Hswap.
    + apply subtyp_refl.
Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_step_let_right mode G e fs h s ua ub S T Ts T0 La Lb L :
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk (trm_let s ua) fs h e La) T0 ->
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk (trm_let s ub) fs h e Lb) T0 ->
  (forall x, x \\notin L ->
    〈G §ˣ x ~ S⁏e ⊢ open x ua ∶ T〉
      ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼>
    〈G §ˣ x ~ S⁏e ⊢ open x ub ∶ T〉) ->
  ty_trm mode G objctx_empty e s S ->
  @ty_stack mode G e Ts fs T0 ->
  subtyp mode G objctx_empty e T Ts ->
  typed_red_closure mode G (config_mk (trm_let s ua) fs h e La) T0 1 G (let_pushed s ua fs h e La) /\\
  typed_red_closure mode G (config_mk (trm_let s ub) fs h e Lb) T0 1 G (let_pushed s ub fs h e Lb) /\\
  〈G ⊢ (let_pushed s ua fs h e La) ∶ T0〉
    ∼(call_swap_relation mode)∼>
  〈G ⊢ (let_pushed s ub fs h e Lb) ∶ T0〉.
Proof.
  intros Htya Htyb Hswap Hs Hstack Hsub.
  repeat split; try (apply one_typed_let_push; assumption).
  pose proof (let_push_preservation Htya) as Htya'.
  pose proof (let_push_preservation Htyb) as Htyb'.
  unfold let_pushed. eapply trf_iterate_S.
  - apply trf_iterate_0. exact Htya'.
  - right. eapply trf_lift_idtyp_conf_stack with (Tt := S).
    + eapply swap_calls_config_accessories. exact Htya'.
    + eapply swap_calls_config_accessories. exact Htyb'.
    + inversion Htya'; assumption.
    + eapply trf_lift_idtyp_stack_e with (L := L \\u ctx_dom G); [|exact Hstack].
      intros x Hx. apply notin_union in Hx as [HxL HxG].
      eapply local_swap_widen; [apply Hswap; exact HxL |].
      now apply weaken_under_fresh_binder.
    + exact Hs.
Qed.

Fixpoint deref_base A (su: SubstVar A) (e: renv) (X: A): A :=
  match e with

  | cons (w,y) ys => (deref_base su ys (subst_var w y X))
  end.

Class Deref A :=

Instance deref_var: Deref var := deref_base VarSubstVar.

Instance deref_avar: Deref avar := deref_base AvarSubstVar.

Instance deref_def: Deref def :=
fun e d => match d with
| def_fld l x => def_fld l (deref e x)
| def_met l t => def_met l t
| def_typ l T => def_typ l T
end.

Fixpoint deref_defs_fix(e: renv)(ds: defs) :=
match ds with
| defs_nil => defs_nil
| defs_cons ds d => defs_cons (deref_defs_fix e ds) (deref_def e d)

  fv_in_values fv_value (E & F) = fv_in_values fv_value E \\u fv_in_values fv_value F.

  induction F using env_ind.
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. symmetry. apply union_empty_r.
  - rewrite concat_assoc, "'!replay_fv_env_push, IHF.
    apply fset_extens; intros z Hz; repeat rewrite in_union in *; tauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma deref_base_concat {A : Set} (S : SubstVar A) E F (a : A) :
  deref_base S (E & F) a = deref_base S E (deref_base S F a).
Proof.
  revert a. induction F using env_ind; intro a.
  - rewrite concat_empty_r. reflexivity.
  - rewrite concat_assoc.
    change (deref_base S (E & F) (subst_var x v a) =
      deref_base S E (deref_base S F (subst_var x v a))).
    apply IHF.

Local Lemma replay_deref_defs_concat E F ds :
  deref (E & F) ds = deref E (deref F ds).
Proof.
  induction ds; [reflexivity |].
  change (defs_cons (deref (E & F) ds) (deref (E & F) d) =
    defs_cons (deref E (deref F ds)) (deref E (deref F d))).
  rewrite IHds. f_equal.
  destruct d; try reflexivity.
  change (def_fld f (deref_base AvarSubstVar (E & F) a) =
    def_fld f (deref_base AvarSubstVar E (deref_base AvarSubstVar F a))).
  now rewrite deref_base_concat.
Qed.

Local Lemma replay_deref_avar_fresh E a :
  (forall v, v '"\\in fv a -> v # E) ->
  deref E a = a.
Proof.
  induction E using env_ind; intros Hfresh.
  - reflexivity.
  - change (deref E (subst_var x v a) = a).
    assert (Heq : subst_var x v a = a).
    {
      destruct a as [i | y]; [reflexivity |].
      assert (Hxy : y <> x).
      { intro Heq. subst y.
        assert (Hx : x \\in fv (avar_f x)).
        { change (x \\in \\{x}). now rewrite in_singleton. }
        specialize (Hfresh x Hx).
        apply Hfresh. rewrite dom_push, in_union, in_singleton. auto. }
      cbn. case_if; congruence.
    }
    rewrite Heq. apply IHE. intros z Hz HzE.
    eapply Hfresh; [exact Hz |].
    rewrite dom_push, in_union. auto.

  (forall v, v \\in fv ds -> v # E) ->
  deref E ds = ds.

  induction ds as [|ds IH d]; intro Hfresh; [reflexivity |].
  change (defs_cons (deref E ds) (deref E d) = defs_cons ds d).

  - apply IH. intros x Hx. apply Hfresh.
    change (x \\in fv ds \\u fv d). rewrite in_union. auto.
  - destruct d; try reflexivity.

    f_equal. apply replay_deref_avar_fresh. intros x Hx. apply Hfresh.

  heap_update (H & S) x a y (H & S').
Proof.
  intros Hextra Hsep [Hok [Hok' [Hdom [Hrest [ds [ds' [Hitem [Hupdate Hitem']]]]]]]].
  unfold heap_update. repeat split.
  - apply replay_ok_concat; assumption.

  - rewrite "'!dom_concat. now rewrite Hdom.
  - intros z v Hneq Hz.
    apply binds_concat_inv in Hz. destruct Hz as [Hb | [Hout Hb]].
    + apply binds_concat_right. now apply Hrest.
    + apply binds_concat_left; [exact Hb |]. now rewrite <- Hdom.
  - exists ds, ds'"'. repeat split; auto using binds_concat_right.
Qed.

  fv_config (extend_machine H E L C) \\c fv_config C \\u extension_variables H E.
Proof.
  intros Hmask x Hx. destruct C.
  cbn [extend_machine] in Hx.
  rewrite "'!dom_concat, !replay_fv_env_concat in Hx.
  specialize (Hmask x).
  unfold extension_variables in *.
  repeat rewrite in_union in *. tauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma fresh_vars_notin L xs n :
  fresh L n xs ->
  forall x, x '"\\in from_list xs -> x \\notin L.
Proof.
  revert n L. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros [|n] L H x Hx; cbn [fresh] in H;
    try contradiction.
  - rewrite from_list_nil, in_empty in Hx. contradiction.
  - rewrite from_list_cons, in_union, in_singleton in Hx.
    destruct H as [Hy Hrest]. destruct Hx as [-> | Hx]; [exact Hy |].
    apply (notin_union _ _ _).1 in (IH _ _ Hrest _ Hx).
Qed.

Local Lemma fresh_decrease_set L L' xs n :
  L' \\c L -> fresh L n xs -> fresh L' n xs.
Proof.
  revert n L L'. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros [|n] L L' Hsub H;
    cbn [fresh] in *; try contradiction; auto.
  destruct H as [Hy Hrest]. split.
  - intro H. apply Hy. now apply Hsub.
  - eapply IH; [|exact Hrest].
    intros z Hz. rewrite in_union in *. destruct Hz; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma fresh_add_avoided_set L X xs n :
  fresh L n xs ->
  (forall x, x \\in from_list xs -> x \\notin X) ->
  fresh (L \\u X) n xs.
Proof.
  revert n L X. induction xs as [|y ys IH]; intros [|n] L X H Havoid;
    cbn [fresh] in *; try contradiction; auto.
  destruct H as [Hy Hrest]. split.
  - apply notin_union. split; [exact Hy |].
    apply Havoid. rewrite from_list_cons, in_union, in_singleton. auto.
  - eapply fresh_decrease_set; [|eapply IH; [exact Hrest |]].
    + intros z Hz. repeat rewrite in_union in *. tauto.
    + intros x Hx. apply Havoid. rewrite from_list_cons, in_union. auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma replay_fresh H E L C D xs n :
  L \\c fv_config C \\u extension_variables H E ->
  (forall v, v \\in fv_config D -> v \\notin fv_config C ->
     v \\notin extension_variables H E) ->
  from_list xs \\c fv_config D ->
  fresh (fv_config C) n xs ->
  fresh (fv_config (extend_machine H E L C)) n xs.
Proof.
  intros Hmask Hnew Hnames Hfresh.
  eapply fresh_decrease_set; [apply extend_machine_variable_bound; exact Hmask |].
  eapply fresh_add_avoided_set; [exact Hfresh |].
  intros x Hx. apply Hnew.
  - now apply Hnames.
  - eapply fresh_vars_notin; eassumption.
Qed.

  repeat rewrite in_union. auto 8.

  (forall x, x \\in fv_config D -> x \\notin fv_config C ->

  same_bindings e f -> dom e = dom f.
Proof.

    destruct Hb as [[-> ->] | [Hneq Hb]];

  - rewrite replay_fv_env_push, in_union, IH.
    split.
    + intros [Hnew | [y [u [Hy Hu]]]].
      * exists w, v. split; auto using binds_push_eq.
      * exists y, u. split; [|exact Hu].
        apply binds_push_neq; [exact Hy |].
        intro Heq. subst y. eapply binds_fresh_inv; eassumption.
    + intros [y [u [Hy Hu]]]. apply binds_push_inv in Hy.
      destruct Hy as [[_ ->] | [_ Hy]]; [now left |].
      right; eauto.

Inductive trf_swap_calls_local: TermTransform :=
  trf_swap_calls_local_at (x1 x2: var) (m1 m2: met_label) (xp1 xp2 y1 y2: var) t G e (T1 T2 T TZ1 TZ2: typ):
    ctx_ok G ->
    ok e ->
    closed t ->
    fresh (ctx_dom G \u ctx_fv G \u fv_renv e \u fv T \u fv T1 \u fv T2) 2 (y1::y2::nil)%list ->

    G ⁏ e ⊢ x1 ∶ ❪❴ᵐ m1 ∶ 𝖭 , TZ1 → ⊤ ❵❫ ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ x2 ∶ ❪❴ᵐ m2 ∶ 𝖭 , TZ2 → ⊤ ❵❫ ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ ❪𝖭❫ <: TZ1 ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ ❪𝖭❫ <: TZ2 ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ ❪Call $x1․m1 $xp1❫ ∶ T1 ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ ❪Call $x2․m2 $xp2❫ ∶ T2 ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ xp1 ∶ TZ1 ->
    G ⁏ e ⊢ xp2 ∶ TZ2 ->
    G §ˣ y2 ~ T2 §ˣ y1 ~ T1 ⁏ e ⊢ t ∶ T ->
    〈G ⁏ e ⊢ ❪Let y1=Call $x1․m1 $xp1 In Let y2=Call $x2․m2 $xp2 In t❫ ∶ T〉 ∼trf_swap_calls_local∼> 〈G ⁏ e ⊢ ❪Let y2=Call $x2․m2 $xp2 In Let y1=Call $x1․m1 $xp1 In t❫ ∶ T〉.

End WithTypingMode.

  (typ_and Tstrip (typ_cap_adapt C w1 Tcap)) (only parsing).

Notation ref_read_ref_type C R1 Tstrip w1 Tcap :=
  (typ_objref R1 (typ_cap_marker C (typ_or Tcap (typ_sel (avar_f w1) (typ_label_refcap C) (avar_b 0))))) (only parsing).

  (ref_read_ref_type typ_refcap_mutability R1 Tstrip w1 Tcap) (only parsing).

Notation typ_read_ref typing_mode G e fs T0 T2 R1 R2 w1 T3 Tcap := (
  match (mode_viewpoint_adaptation' typing_mode) with
  | mode_viewpoint_adaptation_same =>

      T2 = (typ_objref R1 R2)
  | mode_viewpoint_adapt_mutability =>
      exists Tstrip Tcap,
        G ⁏ e ⊢ T3 ∶icp Tstrip /\
        G ⁏ e ⊢ T3 ∶cpb ⟦ typ_refcap_mutability ⟧ Tcap /\
        ty_stack G e (rodot_read_term_type Tstrip w1 Tcap) fs T0 /\

        T2 = (rodot_read_ref_type R1 Tstrip w1 Tcap)
  end) (only parsing).

Context (typing_mode: Mode).

Inductive typed_red : ctx -> config -> typ -> ctx -> config -> Prop :=












| tred_read_obj : forall (F F' : ctx) (w1 w2 y1 y2 : var) (a : fld_label)

    exists k l rest Ga' Gb' Ca' Cb',

      typed_red_closure mode Gb Cb T l Gb' Cb' /\

    exists m Gb' Cb',

  - destruct (swap_calls_answer_typed_trace Ha Hrun) as [-> [-> ->]].

    + eapply swap_calls_append_typed_steps; eassumption.

Inductive red : config -> config -> Prop :=

| red_read : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yVal wVal ds fs,
    fresh_in_config (wVal :: nil) (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->

    defs_has ds (def_fld m (avar_f yVal)) ->

      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wVal); fs; Sigma; e & wVal ~ yVal; fv_config (trm_read (avar_f wObj) m; fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_write : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv yArg wArg Sigma' fs,
    heap_update Sigma yObj m yArg Sigma' ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    binds wArg yArg e ->
    (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (trm_var (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma'; e; fv_config (trm_write (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_call : forall yObj wObj m Sigma e Lv wArg t ds fs,
    binds yObj (item_obj ds) Sigma ->
    defs_has ds (def_met m t) ->
    binds wObj yObj e ->
    (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ ((open wArg (open_rec 1 wObj t)); fs ; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_call (avar_f wObj) m (avar_f wArg); fs ; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_apply : forall yFun wFun wArg Sigma e Lv t fs,
    binds yFun (item_fun t) Sigma ->
    binds wFun yFun e ->
    (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open wArg t; fs; Sigma; e; fv_config (trm_apply (avar_f wFun) (avar_f wArg); fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_fun : forall T t1 t2 Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    y <> w ->
    (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t2 ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_fun t1); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_fun T t1) t2 ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_obj : forall T ds t Sigma e Lv y w fs,
    fresh_in_config (y :: w :: nil) (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv) ->
    w <> y ->
    (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open w t ; fs; Sigma & y ~ (item_obj (deref_defs (e & w ~ y) (open w ds))); e & w ~ y ; fv_config (trm_lit (lit_obj T ds) t ; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_var : forall t Sigma e Lv x fs,
    (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (open x t; fs; Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_var (avar_f x); (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e; Lv))

| red_let_push : forall s t fs Sigma e Lv,
    (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv)
      ↦ (s; (stack_cons (frame_let t) fs); Sigma; e ; fv_config (trm_let s t; fs; Sigma; e; Lv))

where "t1 ↦ t2" := (red t1 t2).

Inductive answer: config -> Prop :=
| nf_loc: forall x Sigma e Lv, answer (trm_var (avar_f x); stack_nil; Sigma; e; Lv).

         (at level 40, n at level 41, C2 at level 39).

Inductive red_closure :  config -> nat -> config -> Prop :=

| red_refl : forall (C : config),
    C ⊣ 0 ↦* C

| red_trans : forall (C1 C2 C3 : config) (n : nat),
    C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2 ->
    C2      ↦  C3 ->
    C1 ⊣ S n ↦* C3

where "C1 ⊣ n ↦* C2" := (red_closure C1 n C2).

Definition config_terminates_in C n :=
 (exists (Ca : config), answer Ca /\ (C ⊣n↦* Ca)).

Definition config_terminates C :=
 (exists (n : nat), config_terminates_in C n).

  intro H. induction H; cbn [ctx_kdom]; case_if; try congruence;
    rewrite ?in_union, ?in_singleton; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma kinded_binding_in_suffix x k T G G' :
  ctx_binds_k_after x k T G G' -> forall k', ctx_kdom k' G' \c ctx_kdom k' G.
Proof.
  intro H. induction H; intros k' z0 Hv; cbn [ctx_kdom];
    case_if; rewrite ?in_union; auto;
    try right; eapply IHctx_binds_k_after; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma reference_target_in_context mode G e w y :
  @renv_corr mode G e -> binds w y e -> y \in ctx_kdom v_loc G.
Proof.
  intros Hcorr. induction Hcorr; intro Hbind.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv; eassumption.
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hbind.
    destruct Hbind as [[-> ->] | [_ Hbind]].
    + eapply kinded_binding_in_suffix.
      * eassumption.
      * eapply kinded_binding_in_context; eassumption.
    + auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma no_functions_in_mutability_mode mode :
  mode_has_mutability mode -> mode_has_fun' mode = false.
Proof. destruct mode; simpl; congruence. Qed.

Local Lemma reference_lookup mode G e h w :
  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  @heap_correspond mode G e h ->
  ctx_k G w v_ref ->
  exists y ds, binds w y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) h /\ defs_varkinds G ds.
Proof.
  intros Hmut [_ [_ [_ [_ [Hloc [Href [Henv Hitems]]]]]]]
    [T [G' Hbind]].
  assert (Hdom : w \in dom e).
  { rewrite <- Href. eapply kinded_binding_in_context; eassumption. }
  destruct (get_some Hdom) as [y Hy].
  assert (HdomY : y \in dom h).
  { rewrite <- Hloc. eapply reference_target_in_context; eassumption. }
  specialize (Hitems _ HdomY). destruct Hitems.
  - destruct mode; simpl in *; discriminate.
  - eexists _, _. repeat split; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma def_lookup_kinded G ds d :
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds d -> def_varkinds G d.
Proof.
  intro H. induction H; unfold defs_has in *; cbn [get_def]; intro Hget.
  - discriminate.
  - case_if. 
    + inversion Hget; subst. assumption.
    + auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma lookup_field_location G ds a v :
  defs_varkinds G ds -> defs_has ds (def_fld a v) ->
  exists y, v = avar_f y /\ ctx_k G y v_loc.
Proof.
  intros Hdefs Hhas.
  pose proof (def_lookup_kinded Hdefs Hhas) as Hkind. inversion Hkind; subst.
  eexists. split; [reflexivity | eassumption].
Qed.

Local Lemma heap_lookup_transport mode G t fs h e Lv T w :
  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk t fs h e Lv) T ->
  tfree_trm w t ->
  exists y ds, binds w y e /\ binds y (item_obj ds) h /\ defs_varkinds G ds.
Proof.
  intros Hmut Hty Hfree. inversion Hty; subst.
  eapply reference_lookup; [exact Hmut | eassumption |].
  match goal with H : all_tfree_k _ t v_ref |- _ =>
    apply H; exact Hfree
  end.
Qed.

Local Lemma defs_update_has_field ds a v y :
  defs_has ds (def_fld a v) -> exists ds', defs_update ds a y ds'.
Proof.
  unfold defs_has; cbn [label_of DefLabelOf].
  induction ds as [|ds IH d]; cbn [get_def]; intro H.
  - discriminate.
  - case_if.
    + inversion H; subst. eexists. constructor.
    + destruct (IH H) as [ds' Hds']. exists (defs_cons ds' d).
      apply defs_update_push; assumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma replace_heap_item (h : heap) x i i' :
  ok h ->
  binds x i h ->
  exists h',
    ok h' /\ dom h' = dom h /\ binds x i' h' /\
    (forall z v, z <> x -> binds z v h -> binds z v h').
Proof.
  intros Hok. induction Hok as [|h z v Hok IH Hfresh]; intro Hbind.
  - exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv; eassumption.
  - apply binds_push_inv in Hbind. destruct Hbind as [[-> ->] | [Hneq Hbind]].
    + exists (h & z ~ i'). repeat split.
      * apply ok_push; assumption.
      * now rewrite !dom_push.
      * apply binds_push_eq.
      * intros z' v' Hneq' Hbind. apply binds_push_inv in Hbind.
        destruct Hbind as [[Heq _] | [_ Hbind]]; [congruence |].
        apply binds_push_neq; assumption.
    + destruct (IH Hbind) as [h' [Hok' [Hdom [Hbind' Hothers]]]].
      exists (h' & z ~ v). repeat split.
      * apply ok_push; [exact Hok' |]. unfold notin in *. rewrite Hdom. exact Hfresh.
      * now rewrite !dom_push, Hdom.
      * apply binds_push_neq; assumption.
      * intros z' v' Hneq' Hbind''. apply binds_push_inv in Hbind''.
        destruct Hbind'' as [[-> ->] | [Hneq'' Hb]].
        -- apply binds_push_eq.
        -- apply binds_push_neq; auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma update_existing_field h x ds a v y :
  ok h ->
  binds x (item_obj ds) h ->
  defs_has ds (def_fld a v) ->
  exists h', heap_update h x a y h'.
Proof.
  intros Hok Hbind Hfield.
  destruct (defs_update_has_field y Hfield) as [ds' Hds'].
  destruct (replace_heap_item (item_obj ds') Hok Hbind)
    as [h' [Hok' [Hdom [Hbind' Hothers]]]].
  exists h'. repeat split; try assumption.
  - symmetry. assumption.
  - exists ds, ds'. auto.
Qed.

Local Lemma typed_call_with_member mode G w p a fs h e Lv T :
  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk (trm_call (avar_f w) a (avar_f p)) fs h e Lv) T ->
  (forall y ds, binds w y e -> binds y (item_obj ds) h ->
    exists body, defs_has ds (def_met a body)) ->
  exists G' C', typed_red mode G (config_mk (trm_call (avar_f w) a (avar_f p)) fs h e Lv) T G' C'.
Proof.
  intros Hmut Htype Hmember.
  destruct (heap_lookup_transport Hmut Htype (tfree_trm_call_l w (avar_f p) a))
    as [y [ds [Href [Hloc Hkind]]]].
  destruct (Hmember y ds Href Hloc) as [body Hbody].
  assert (Hin : inert (typing_mode := mode) G) by (inversion Htype; assumption).
  eexists _, _. eapply (@tred_call mode G w w p y p); eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma typed_write_with_member mode G w p a fs h e Lv T :
  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk (trm_write (avar_f w) a (avar_f p)) fs h e Lv) T ->
  (forall y ds, binds w y e -> binds y (item_obj ds) h ->
    exists v, defs_has ds (def_fld a v)) ->
  exists G' C', typed_red mode G (config_mk (trm_write (avar_f w) a (avar_f p)) fs h e Lv) T G' C'.
Proof.
  intros Hmut Htype Hmember.
  destruct (heap_lookup_transport Hmut Htype (tfree_trm_write_l w (avar_f p) a))
    as [y [ds [Href [Hloc Hkind]]]].
  destruct (heap_lookup_transport Hmut Htype (tfree_trm_write_r (avar_f w) p a))
    as [z [dz [Harg [_ _]]]].
  destruct (Hmember y ds Href Hloc) as [v Hfield].
  assert (Hin : inert (typing_mode := mode) G) by (inversion Htype; assumption).
  assert (Hok : ok h).
  { inversion Htype; subst.
    match goal with Hcorr : heap_correspond _ _ _ |- _ =>
      destruct Hcorr as [_ [_ [Hok _]]]; exact Hok
    end. }
  destruct (update_existing_field z Hok Hloc Hfield) as [h' Hupdate].
  eexists _, _. eapply tred_write; eauto.
Qed.

Local Definition free_control_head (t : trm) :=
  match t with
  | trm_var v => exists w, v = avar_f w
  | trm_read v _ => exists w, v = avar_f w
  | trm_write v _ p | trm_call v _ p | trm_apply v p =>
      exists w u, v = avar_f w /\ p = avar_f u
  | trm_let _ _ | trm_lit _ _ => True
  end.

Local Lemma typing_has_free_head mode G e t T :
  ty_trm mode G objctx_empty e t T ->
  free_control_head t.
Proof. intro H. induction H; cbn; eauto. Qed.

Local Definition needs_heap_step (t : trm) :=
  match t with
  | trm_call _ _ _ | trm_apply _ _ | trm_read _ _ | trm_write _ _ _ => True
  | _ => False
  end.

Local Lemma typed_control_can_continue mode G t fs h e Lv T :
  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  @ty_config mode G (config_mk t fs h e Lv) T ->
  ~ needs_heap_step t ->
  answer (config_mk t fs h e Lv) \/
  exists G' C', typed_red mode G (config_mk t fs h e Lv) T G' C'.
Proof.
  intros Hmut Htype Hcontrol.
  destruct t; cbn [needs_heap_step] in Hcontrol; try contradiction.
  - assert (Hfree : free_control_head (trm_var a)).
    { inversion Htype; subst. eapply typing_has_free_head; eassumption. }
    destruct Hfree as [w ->].
    destruct fs as [|[u] fs].
    + left. constructor.
    + right. eexists _, _. eapply tred_let_var; eauto.
      inversion Htype; assumption.
  - right. eapply typed_let_can_step; [exact Hmut | exact Htype |].
    left. eauto.
  - right. eapply typed_let_can_step; [exact Hmut | exact Htype |].
    right. eauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma local_swap_widen mode G e ta tb T T' :
  〈G⁏e ⊢ ta ∶ T〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ tb ∶ T〉 ->
  subtyp mode G objctx_empty e T T' ->
  〈G⁏e ⊢ ta ∶ T'〉 ∼(trf_local_idtyp_trm mode (trf_swap_calls_local mode))∼> 〈G⁏e ⊢ tb ∶ T'〉.
Proof.
  intros H Hsub. inversion H; subst; unfold subtyping in *.
  all: try solve [eapply trf_local_idtyp_trm_local; unfold subtyping; try eassumption; eapply subtyp_trans; [eassumption | exact Hsub]].

Local Lemma swap_calls_typed_step_erases mode G1 G2 C1 C2 T :
  typed_red mode G1 C1 T G2 C2 ->

Proof.
  intro Hstep. destruct Hstep; subst;
    eauto using red_read, red_write, red_call, red_apply, red_let_fun,
      red_let_var, red_let_push.
  apply red_let_obj; [assumption |].

Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_typed_run_erases mode G1 G2 C1 C2 T n :
  typed_red_closure mode G1 C1 T n G2 C2 ->
  C1 ⊣n↦* C2.
Proof.
  intro Hrun. induction Hrun.
  - apply red_refl.
  - eapply red_trans; [exact IHHrun | eapply swap_calls_typed_step_erases; eassumption].
Qed.

Local Lemma swap_calls_free_open :
  (forall x t, tfree_trm x t -> forall k y, tfree_trm x (open_rec k y t)) /\

  (forall x d, tfree_def x d -> forall k y, tfree_def x (open_rec k y d)) /\
  (forall x ds, tfree_defs x ds -> forall k y, tfree_defs x (open_rec k y ds)).
Proof.
  apply (tfree_mutind
    (fun x t _ => forall k y, tfree_trm x (open_rec k y t))
    (fun x l _ => forall k y, tfree_lit x (open_rec k y l))
    (fun x d _ => forall k y, tfree_def x (open_rec k y d))
    (fun x ds _ => forall k y, tfree_defs x (open_rec k y ds))).

| is_sealed_rcd : forall n D, is_sealed_dec n D -> is_sealed_typ n (typ_rcd D)

                             is_sealed_typ n (typ_or T1 T2)

                             is_sealed_typ n (typ_fun T1 T2)
| is_sealed_nocap : forall n, is_sealed_typ n typ_nocap
with is_sealed_dec : nat -> dec -> Prop :=
| is_sealed_dec_typ : forall n L T U, is_sealed_typ (S n) T ->
                                 is_sealed_typ (S n) U ->

                                 is_sealed_typ n U ->

                                      is_sealed_dec n (dec_met L TC TZ TR).

Proof.

  - intros w S H. inversion H; subst; eauto using ctx_binds.
  - intros w H. inversion H; subst; eauto using ctx_vis.
Qed.

Local Lemma ctx_extends_hide G G' :
  ctx_extends G G' -> ctx_extends (ctx_hide G) (ctx_hide G').
Proof.

  - intros w S H. inversion H; subst. constructor. now apply Hbind.
  - intros w H. inversion H.
Qed.

Local Lemma ctx_extends_types :

  (forall G Go e S T, subtyp m G Go e S T ->

  (forall G Go e S T, ty_incap m G Go e S T ->
   forall G', ctx_extends G G' -> ty_incap m G' Go e S T).
Proof.
  apply (@ts_mutind m
    (fun G Go e x T _ => forall G', ctx_extends G G' -> ty_var m G' Go e x T)
    (fun G Go e S T _ => forall G', ctx_extends G G' -> subtyp m G' Go e S T)
    (fun G Go e S T _ => forall G', ctx_extends G G' -> ty_incap m G' Go e S T)).
  all: intros; extend_typing_context.
  all: solve [econstructor; unfold obj_typing, subtyping, obj_ref_incap in *;

Local Lemma types_under_binding_extension mode :
  (forall G Go e x T, ty_var mode G Go e x T ->

  (forall G Go e S T, subtyp mode G Go e S T ->

  (forall G Go e S T, ty_incap mode G Go e S T ->

    (fun G Go e S T _ => forall G', bindings_extend G G' -> subtyp mode G' Go e S T)

Local Lemma ctx_cap_bound_under_morphism mode C G Go e S T :
  ty_capbnd mode C G Go e S T ->
  forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' -> ty_capbnd mode C G' Go e S T.
Proof.
  destruct (ctx_types_under_morphism mode) as [Hvar _].
  intro H. induction H; intros G' HM;
    solve [econstructor; unfold obj_typing, obj_cap_bnd in *; eauto].
Qed.

Local Lemma ctx_viewpoint_under_morphism mode x G Go e S T :
  viewpoint_adapt mode x G Go e S T ->
  forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' -> viewpoint_adapt mode x G' Go e S T.
Proof.
  destruct (ctx_types_under_morphism mode) as [_ [_ Hincap]].
  unfold viewpoint_adapt. destruct (mode_viewpoint_adaptation' mode); auto.
  intros H G' HM. destruct H.
  constructor; unfold obj_ref_incap, obj_cap_bnd in *.
  - eauto.
  - eapply ctx_cap_bound_under_morphism; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Definition objctx_self_fresh G Go :=
  forall x, x \\in objctx_dom Go -> x \\notin ctx_dom G.

Local Lemma ctx_typing_morphism_object mode e G G' Go :
  ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->
  objctx_self_fresh G Go ->
  ctx_typing_morphism mode e (G §§& Go) (G' §§& Go).
Proof.
  destruct Go; cbn [ctx_obj]; auto.
  intros H HM. apply ctx_typing_morphism_push; [exact H |].
  apply HM. cbn [objctx_dom]. now rewrite in_singleton.
Qed.

Local Lemma ctx_typing_morphism_for_method mode e G G' Go z TZ c TC :
  ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->
  objctx_self_fresh G Go ->
  z \\notin (objctx_dom Go \\u ctx_dom G) ->
  c \\notin (objctx_dom Go \\u ctx_dom G) ->
  c <> z ->
  ctx_typing_morphism mode e
    (ctx_obj_met mode G Go z TZ c TC) (ctx_obj_met mode G' Go z TZ c TC).
Proof.
  intros HM Hself Hz Hc Hneq.
  pose proof (ctx_typing_morphism_object HM Hself) as HMself.
  destruct Go; destruct (mode_visibility' mode) eqn:Hvis;
    cbn [ctx_obj_met] in *; rewrite Hvis;
    apply ctx_typing_morphism_push;
    [apply ctx_typing_morphism_push;
      try apply ctx_typing_morphism_hide;
      exact HMself
    |..];
    cbn [ctx_dom objctx_dom] in *;
    rewrite ?union_empty_l, ?notin_union, ?notin_singleton in *; tauto.
Qed.

Local Lemma ctx_terms_under_morphism mode :
  (forall G Go e t T, ty_trm mode G Go e t T ->
    forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->
      objctx_self_fresh G Go -> ty_trm mode G' Go e t T) /\\
  (forall G Go e l T, ty_lit mode G Go e l T ->
    forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->
      objctx_self_fresh G Go -> ty_lit mode G' Go e l T) /\\
  (forall G Go e d D, ty_def mode G Go e d D ->
    forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->
      objctx_self_fresh G Go -> ty_def mode G' Go e d D) /\\
  (forall G Go e ds T, ty_defs mode G Go e ds T ->
    forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->

  apply (@rules_mutind mode
    (fun G Go e t T _ => forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->
      objctx_self_fresh G Go -> ty_trm mode G' Go e t T)
    (fun G Go e l T _ => forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->
      objctx_self_fresh G Go -> ty_lit mode G' Go e l T)
    (fun G Go e d D _ => forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->

    (fun G Go e ds T _ => forall G', ctx_typing_morphism mode e G G' ->
      objctx_self_fresh G Go -> ty_defs mode G' Go e ds T)).
  all: intros; unfold obj_typing, obj_dec_typing, subtyping, obj_ref_incap in *.
  all: match goal with HM : ctx_typing_morphism _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
    let Hv := fresh \"Hvisible\" in pose proof (proj2 (proj2 HM)) as Hv
    end.
  all: try solve [econstructor; intros; eauto 5 using ctx_viewpoint_under_morphism].
  all: match goal with HM : ctx_typing_morphism _ _ ?G _ |- _ =>
    match goal with

    end end.
  all: unfold obj_typing, obj_dec_typing in *; try solve [eauto].
  all: intros; repeat match goal with H : _ \\notin ?Ls \\u ctx_dom _ |- _ =>
    apply notin_union in H as [? ?] end.

  (ctx_nothing_fresh_in_config G c  /\ nothing_fresh_in_config U c ).

Notation has_null Lv := (exists null, null \in Lv).

Notation inert_G_for_item G w y T := (G § y / v_loc ~ T § w / v_ref ~ T).

Notation inert_G_for_obj G w y T S := (inert_G_for_item G w y (typ_objref T S)).

Local Lemma specialize_last_binding mode G e x vk S U :
  x \\notin ctx_dom G ->
  subtyp mode G objctx_empty e S U ->
  ctx_typing_morphism mode e (G § x / vk ~ U) (G § x / vk ~ S).
Proof.
  intros Hx Hsub. split; [reflexivity |]. split.
  - intros y T Hb. inversion Hb; subst.
    + eapply ty_var_sub with (T := S).
      * apply ty_var_var, ctx_binds_e.
      * unfold subtyping.
        eapply (proj1 (proj2 (ctx_extends_types mode))); [exact Hsub |].
        now apply ctx_extends_with_fresh.
    + apply ty_var_var. apply ctx_binds_n; assumption.
  - intros y Hy. inversion Hy; subst; eauto using ctx_vis.
Qed.

Local Lemma stack_narrow_input mode G e fs S U T :
  @ty_stack mode G e U fs T ->
  subtyp mode G objctx_empty e S U ->
  @ty_stack mode G e S fs T.
Proof.
  intros Hstack Hsub. destruct Hstack as [G e U T Hout | L G e fs u U V T Htail Hbody].
  - apply ty_stack_nil. unfold subtyping in *.
    eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
  - apply ty_stack_let with (L := L \\u ctx_dom G) (T := V); [exact Htail |].
    intros x Hx. apply notin_union in Hx as [HxL HxG].
    eapply (proj1 (ctx_terms_under_morphism mode)).
    + exact (Hbody x HxL).
    + now apply specialize_last_binding.
    + apply objctx_self_fresh_empty.
Qed.

Local Lemma invert_read_type mode G e w a U :
  ty_trm mode G objctx_empty e (trm_read (avar_f w) a) U ->
  exists W R V,
    ty_var mode G objctx_empty e w (typ_rcd (dec_fld a W R)) /\\
    viewpoint_adapt mode w G objctx_empty e R V /\\
    subtyp mode G objctx_empty e V U.
Proof.
  intro H. remember (trm_read (avar_f w) a) as t eqn:Ht.
  induction H; try discriminate; unfold obj_typing, subtyping in *.
  - inversion Ht; subst. exists S, T, U. repeat split; auto using subtyp_refl.
  - destruct (IHty_trm Ht) as [W [R [V [Hfield [Hview Hsub]]]]].
    exists W, R, V. repeat split; try assumption. eapply subtyp_trans; eassumption.
Qed.

Local Lemma read_continuation_type mode G e w a U T fs :
  ty_trm mode G objctx_empty e (trm_read (avar_f w) a) U ->
  @ty_stack mode G e U fs T ->
  mode_has_mutability mode ->
  exists W R TS TC,
    ty_var mode G objctx_empty e w (typ_rcd (dec_fld a W R)) /\\
    ty_incap mode G objctx_empty e R TS /\\
    ty_capbnd mode typ_refcap_mutability G objctx_empty e R TC /\\
    @ty_stack mode G e (rodot_read_term_type TS w TC) fs T.
Proof.
  intros Hread Hstack Hmut.
  destruct (invert_read_type Hread) as [W [R [V [Hfield [Hview Hsub]]]]].
  unfold viewpoint_adapt in Hview.
  assert (Hmode : mode_viewpoint_adaptation' mode = mode_viewpoint_adapt_mutability)
    by (destruct mode; simpl in *; congruence).
  rewrite Hmode in Hview. destruct Hview.
  exists W, R, Tstrip, Tcap. repeat split; try assumption.
  eapply stack_narrow_input; eassumption.
Qed.
EOF
